Statute.Title: Spring Economic Update 2026 Implementation Act
Statute.OtherLangTitle: (Exécution de la mise à jour économique du printemps 2026, Loi d’)

CIF.Text: CIF, 2026, c. 22 in force on assent 18.06.2026, except,

Item.Text: — s. 11(1) deemed in force 20.04.2026 see s. 11(2)
— ss. 13(2), 14(2) and 15(2) come into force 01.04.2028 see respectively ss. 13(4), 14(4) and 15(4) — Not in force
— s. 18 in force on the 120th day after the day on which this Act receives royal assent, see s. 19 (16.10.2026)
— ss. 20(1) and 21 to 35 come into force on a day or days to be fixed by order of the Governor in Council see s. 36(1) — Not in force

— ss. 20(2) to (11) come into force on a day to be fixed by order of the Governor in Council, but that day must not be before the day on which s. 20(1) comes into force see ss. 36(2) to (6) — Not in force
— ss. 38(1) and (4) come into force 07.11.2027 see s. 40(1) — Not in force
— ss. 38(3) and 39 come into force on a day to be fixed by order of the Governor in Council see s. 40(2) — Not in force
— ss. 41 to 43 come into force, in accordance with s. 114(4) of the Canada Pension Plan on a day to be fixed by order of the Governor in Council see s. 44(2) — Not in force
— Note: s. 114(2) of the Canada Pension Plan does not apply in respect of the amendments to that Act contained in ss. 41 to 43 see s. 44(1)
